entries.baseline: n/a — first measurement on this corpus; the entry records the baseline the pack's content will be priced against
entries.content: Profile v1 payload (label-derived relation definitions: Wikidata id + label boilerplate; no endpoint signatures, no extraction intents; guidance renderer emits the fixed 'relations are undirected' line) run over a 30-doc stratified dev sample (seed 20261020)
entries.delta: Raw exact-match recall 0.0726 (86/1,184 gold triples); raw precision 0.544 vs audit-corrected precision 0.987 (machine judgment, P2 pattern). Stage-3 recall decomposition of the 1,098 misses (reachable mass in measured order): endpoint never in the proposal trail ~428 estimated reachable of 843 mechanical (bucket b), pair never proposed ~85 of 170 (c), wrong relation/direction at Tier-1 77 (e), proposed-but-below-Tier-1 7 (d), split-sibling damage 1 (f); an estimated ~495 misses are gold triples the text does not support (Set B calibration). Only 202/609 gold clusters (33.2%) ever appear as a proposal endpoint.
entries.gate: Stage-2 pre-registered audit gates G-AUD-1 / G-AUD-2 (both fired — see the gold audit); stage-3 decomposition completeness asserted by the decomposition pass
entries.instrument: Stage-2 gold audit + stage-3 decomposition (the audit and decomposition records of the main-run design)
entries.population: Re-DocRED dev, 30 documents stratified by length terciles — the same documents are the pack v2 pilot's CONTROL arm population if the paired design (the main-run design, §5) is not used; the pilot design prefers 60 fresh dev docs with both arms on the same population
entries.treatment: Profile v1 (in force at audit time)
entries.verdict: BASELINE RECORDED — recall, not precision, is the open problem on this corpus; gates/bands contribute 7 of 1,098 misses, so threshold tuning is excluded as a recall lever. Pack v2 (authored definitions + signatures + directionality) is priced against this baseline by the stage-4 pilot.

entries.baseline: The pilot's own paired control arm (profile v1 on the same 60 documents); stage-3 audit baseline recorded in DC-1
entries.content: DocRED pack candidate 0.1.0 payload (authored relation definitions + train-derived endpoint signatures + declared directionality, rendered through the directionality renderer mechanism) run as the treatment arm of the stage-4 paired pilot
entries.delta: Ceiling-adjusted recall 0.1455 (v1) -> 0.1511 (v2), delta +0.0056; raw precision 0.5485 -> 0.6144; audit-corrected precision 0.9818 -> 0.9869 (machine judgment, P2 pattern); raw recall 0.0948 -> 0.0984; Tier-1 volume 330 -> 306. Per-bucket miss movement (of 1,920 gold): (b) endpoint never in the proposal trail 1,270 -> 1,376 (+106; both-endpoints subtype 458 -> 565), (c) pair never proposed 240 -> 147 (-93), (d) below Tier-1 8 -> 13, (e) wrong relation/direction at Tier-1 151 -> 126 (direction flips 8 -> 4); (b)+(c) reachable mass 1,510 -> 1,523. Shared Set B ceiling: pair support 0.6515 (129/198), type error 0.1322. Pilot spend $1.6821 of the $5.00 cap.
entries.gate: Stage-4 pre-registered gates G-P1..G-P4 (the main-run design, section 5.2): G-P1 FAIL (delta +0.0056 < +0.05), G-P2 FAIL ((b)+(c) relative fall -0.0086 < 0.20), G-P3 PASS (corrected precision 0.9869, Wilson lower 0.9669, flips did not grow), G-P4 PASS ($0.00221 per doc-run inside the $0.002-0.006 band)
entries.instrument: Stage-4 pilot record (the pilot summary, with both arms' decompositions)
entries.population: Re-DocRED dev, 60 documents disjoint from the audit's 30, stratified by length terciles 20/20/20, seed 20261021; 1,920 gold triples; both arms on the same documents
entries.verdict: NOT ADOPTION-ELIGIBLE — the pre-registered rule requires all four gates; G-P1 and G-P2 failed. The pack bought pair-proposal and typing quality ((c) -93, (e) -25) but endpoint coverage regressed ((b) +106), netting flat recall. Adoption decision D-3 remains a human decision; the pack stays candidate_not_in_force.

entries.baseline: The stage-4c fitted configuration (roster + sentence x standard, legacy answer format) on the same population
entries.content: Stage-8 F1 cell of the judge-fitting line (the JF-F1 design). The stage-7 consistency harness proved on the frozen stage-4c census that the legacy judge's direction flips are an answer-format artifact; the F1 cell re-ran the fitted population under the direction-slot format and passed every pre-registered gate.
entries.delta: Against the stage-4c fitted configuration on the same population: eta 0.1124 -> 0.2596; flips 131 -> 7; candidate precision 0.3464 -> 0.8381
entries.gate: Stage-8 pre-registered gates (the JF-F1 design, section 6): eta >= 0.21 PASS (0.2596); NONE-loss <= 392 PASS (258); flips <= 3% of kept PASS (7 of 2,756 kept); candidate precision >= 0.55 PASS (0.8381); parse family <= 1% PASS (0 of 3,128); orientation accuracy 0.9619
entries.instrument: Stage-8 run record (the f1 scores) and the consistency-harness record
entries.population: Re-DocRED dev, the fitted 60 documents; 3,128 judged pairs
entries.treatment: JF-F1 direction slot on the pair judge (the answer format gains a direction field; BA answers swap endpoints at parse; symmetric relations never swap), over the fitted configuration: roster + pair enumeration, sentence window, standard instruction, v1 payload guidance
entries.verdict: ADOPTED — JF-F1 is part of the fitted production configuration. Ratified into force as emission data by pack 0.2.0 (2026-10-21, stage 11 W-2): the symmetric set is read from packs/open-domain/direction_declarations.json through the profile's pair_judge_symmetric_source key, and the direction slot is wired onto the batch production path (W-1).

entries.baseline: F1 (stage 8, DC-3) on the identical population and census
entries.content: Stage-10 S1 pre-flight cell of the main run (the main-run design, sections 5 and 12): priced the zero-shot hypothesis — that the short-guidance cost ratio would let the main run cover dev 500 more cheaply — against F1 on the same documents before any main-run money was committed.
entries.delta: Cost ratio 0.4669 of F1 (counted from returned usage, both stages); eta 0.2526 vs F1 0.2596; NONE-loss 409 vs F1 258. Of the 41 pairs the declaration structure lost, NONE-loss accounts for 36; F1 converts 4 of those 41 and all 4 died under J5s0.
entries.gate: G-S1-1 eta >= 0.21 PASS (0.2526); G-S1-2 NONE-loss <= 392 FAIL (409 — 17 over; F1's was 258); G-S1-3 parse family <= 1% PASS (0.35%); G-S1-4 flips <= 3% of kept PASS (9)
entries.population: Re-DocRED dev, the fitted 60 documents; 3,128 judged pairs (the identical census to F1)
entries.treatment: J5s0 zero-shot short guidance: schema_front zeroed (proposer_guidance = ''), every other fitted-configuration element held (roster, sentence x standard, JF-F1)
entries.verdict: NOT ADOPTED — a failed pre-registered gate is a failed cell; no post-hoc re-argument. The main run's S2 stage proceeds on F1 at the counted projection; the saving J5s0 promised would have been bought with declaration-structure losses the gates exist to refuse.

entries.baseline: Free triple proposal on the same population (stage 4)
entries.content: Design v2 section 6 assigns this content the slot 'DC-2'; that ID was already held by the stage-4 pilot entry above when the design was written, so the entry is appended under the next free ID with the design slot named here. Stages 4/4b/4c of the judge-fitting line (the judge-fitting design): free proposal measured first, the roster arm added at stage 4b, roster made mandatory (RS-01) at stage 4c after the with/without comparison.
entries.delta: Bucket (b) endpoint-never-proposed losses 809 (free proposal) -> 426 (roster arm); conversion eta 0.1124 under the legacy answer format (the number JF-F1 later raised to 0.2596 — DC-3)
entries.gate: RS-01 (the roster-mandate decision): roster is a mandatory production stage — a document that cannot be rostered is a recorded failure, never a silent free-proposal fallback
entries.instrument: Stages 4/4b/4c run records (the judge-fitting batch record)
entries.population: Re-DocRED dev, the fitted 60 documents (the stage-4 pilot population)
entries.treatment: Roster-first pair enumeration (RS-01): a mention-first roster pass per document, then the sentence-window pair census judged pair by pair — replacing free triple proposal on this family
entries.verdict: ADOPTED — roster + pair enumeration is the production candidate path for this family; the S2 main run (pack 0.2.0) executes it on dev 500.
